summary: Planned 0.7-acre car-free pedestrian paseo along the east wall of Station A (Block 15), connecting Humboldt Street to 23rd Street and opening onto Power Station Park West; designed with Power Station Park by Plural Studio and approved by the Planning Director on June 23, 2022. A Phase 1 open space delivered with Block 15; not built as of the March 2025 annual report.

milestones.text: Draft EIR: 'proposed 0.7-acre plaza-type open space adjacent to Blocks 6 and 10' with gardens, wind canopy/trellis structures and seating
Planning Commission certifies the EIR and recommends approval (D4D dated February 26, 2020: Louisiana Paseo 0.7 acres)
Development Agreement (dated Sept 22, 2020) recital: 'a 0.7-acre plaza type open space (Louisiana Paseo)' as part of the Power Station Park System
Phase 1 application approved: 'Louisiana Plaza - Includes the construction of approximately 0.63 acres of the flexible-use urban plaza'; moved from DA Phase 4 to Phase 1, delivered with Block 15
Required first public (pre-application) meeting for Power Station Park and Louisiana Paseo (online, Sunday Feb 7, 10am)
Design Review Application for Power Station Park and Louisiana Paseo first submitted to Planning (annual reports print the submittal date as '3.23.20')
Updated design review plans submitted in response to initial review comments (plan set dated 7.29.21)
Design review approved by Planning Department staff ('Design review approved, 8.3.21. Memo forthcoming')
Required second public meeting on the modified design; no further modifications required
Planning Director Richard Hillis approves the Design Review Application (Case No. 2017-011878PHA-03; staff memo June 21, 2022); no D4D modifications requested
Design Review Approval for Block 15 (Station A), the building the paseo is delivered with
Station A brick stabilization (Singular Builders, plan by SGH) completed; work ran June-August 2024
2024 annual report: Louisiana Paseo 'Design review approved, 8/3/21. Memo issued 6/23/22'; delivered with Block 15; no construction reported

facts.value: California Barrel Company LLC (project sponsor); now Fifth Space (formerly Associate Capital)
Plural Studio (design review plan sheets dated 7.29.21; CMG names Plural Studio as affiliated landscape architect); D4D concepts by CMG Landscape Architecture

Car-free pedestrian paseo with distinct spaces: paved plaza at 23rd Street for food trucks and small events; seating and possible game tables where it meets Power Station Park; pedestrian passage with seating north to Humboldt Street; 10-foot minimum throughways north-south and east-west (D4D 4.30)
0.7 acres (D4D, DA recital, DEIR); approximately 0.63 acres (Phase 1 application, as 'Louisiana Plaza')
2017-011878PHA-03 (joint Design Review Application with Power Station Park)
Phase 1, delivered with Block 15 (DA originally Phase 4)
Block 15 (Station A) to the west; Blocks 7 and 11 to the east; Station A mid-block passage connects to Georgia Lane
Owned and maintained by the Project Master Association (IMP 9.2)

open_questions: No construction start or completion date found through 2026-09-17; delivery is tied to Block 15 (Station A), whose construction start is not documented in the corpus beyond the 2024 brick stabilization.
No cost figure found for the paseo.

The DEIR describes the paseo as 'adjacent to Blocks 6 and 10' (2018 block numbering); the D4D/Design Review place it between Block 15 and Blocks 7/11. Block renumbering between DEIR and D4D not traced.
The Phase 1 application calls it 'Louisiana Plaza' at 0.63 acres versus 0.7 acres elsewhere; whether this is a scope change or a measurement difference is not stated.
Design review submittal date discrepancy ('3.23.20' in annual reports vs March 23, 2021 in the staff memo) as for Power Station Park.
